topics.title: Building a Pre-Shot Routine
topics.subtitle: Consistent setup for consistent results
topics.defaultPrompt: Help me build an effective pre-shot routine. I know the pros all have one, but I'm not sure what mine should include or how long it should take.
topics.promptTemplate: Help me build an effective pre-shot routine that promotes consistency and confidence. {{skill_level_context}} {{shot_type_context}} {{detail_level_context}}

options.label: Beginner
options.promptFragment: I don't have a pre-shot routine yet — help me build one from scratch.

options.label: Intermediate
options.promptFragment: I have a basic routine but it breaks down under pressure or when I'm playing poorly.

options.label: Advanced
options.promptFragment: I have an established routine but want to refine it for competitive play.

options.label: Full Shots
options.promptFragment: Focus on the pre-shot routine for full shots off the tee and fairway.

options.label: Short Game
options.promptFragment: Focus on the pre-shot routine for chips, pitches, and bunker shots.

options.label: Putting
options.promptFragment: Focus on the pre-putt routine — read, practice strokes, and commitment.

options.label: All Shot Types
options.promptFragment: Cover how the routine should adapt for full shots, short game, and putting.

options.label: Quick Framework
options.promptFragment: Give me a simple framework I can start using next round.

options.label: Detailed Breakdown
options.promptFragment: Break down each element of an effective routine and explain why it matters.

options.label: Tour Pro Examples
options.promptFragment: Include examples of what specific tour pros do in their routines and why it works.

topics.title: Playing Under Pressure
topics.subtitle: Staying focused when the round matters
topics.defaultPrompt: How do I handle pressure and nerves on the golf course? I tend to tighten up on important shots, and my swing changes when I'm nervous.
topics.promptTemplate: How do I handle pressure and nerves on the golf course? My swing changes when I'm nervous. {{skill_level_context}} {{situation_context}} {{detail_level_context}}

options.label: Beginner
options.promptFragment: I get nervous on almost every shot, especially with people watching.

options.label: Intermediate
options.promptFragment: I'm generally OK but tighten up on key shots — first tee, closing holes, short putts.

options.label: Advanced
options.promptFragment: I compete regularly and need tournament-level mental strategies.

options.label: General Pressure
options.promptFragment: Cover general strategies for managing nerves and pressure.

options.label: First Tee Jitters
options.promptFragment: Focus specifically on overcoming first tee anxiety.

options.label: Closing Out a Round
options.promptFragment: Focus on staying composed when trying to close out a good round or match.

options.label: After a Bad Hole
options.promptFragment: Focus on mental recovery after a blow-up hole — how to reset and not let it snowball.

options.label: Quick Tips
options.promptFragment: Give me 3-4 techniques I can use immediately on the course.

options.label: Deep Dive
options.promptFragment: Explain the psychology behind pressure and provide a comprehensive toolkit.

options.label: Mental Exercises
options.promptFragment: Include specific breathing exercises, visualization techniques, and mental rehearsal strategies.

topics.title: Smart Course Management
topics.subtitle: Playing strategically to lower your scores
topics.defaultPrompt: Help me think more strategically on the golf course. I feel like I lose shots to poor decisions rather than poor swings. How should I be picking targets and managing risk?
topics.promptTemplate: Help me think more strategically on the golf course. I lose shots to poor decisions — how should I pick targets and manage risk? {{skill_level_context}} {{course_context}} {{detail_level_context}}

options.label: Beginner
options.promptFragment: I mostly just aim at the flag and hope for the best. Help me think smarter.

options.label: Intermediate
options.promptFragment: I understand basic strategy but don't have a consistent decision-making framework.

options.label: Advanced
options.promptFragment: I want to think like a caddy — strokes gained approach, miss patterns, and situational strategy.

options.label: Overall Strategy
options.promptFragment: Cover a general framework for on-course decision making.

options.label: Tee Shot Strategy
options.promptFragment: Focus on tee shot strategy — when to hit driver, when to lay back, and how to pick targets.

options.label: Approach Shots
options.promptFragment: Focus on approach shot strategy — which side of the green to miss on, when to be aggressive versus conservative.

options.label: Scoring Zone (< 100 yds)
options.promptFragment: Focus on strategy inside 100 yards — maximizing up-and-down percentage and avoiding big numbers.

options.label: Quick Rules
options.promptFragment: Give me simple rules of thumb for better decision making.

options.label: Full Framework
options.promptFragment: Lay out a complete course management framework with examples.

options.label: Scenario Walkthroughs
options.promptFragment: Walk me through specific scenarios so I can learn the decision-making process.
